title: #LenovoChassis

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

MainboardPartNubmer.description: Represents part number of the system's mainboard.
MainboardPartNubmer.longDescription: The value of this property shall represent part number of the system's mainboard.

Sensors.description: This object describes the sensors of the system in general detail.
Sensors.longDescription: This is a reference to sensor. This object shall contain properties which describes the sensors for the current resource.

Slots.description: This is a reference to a collection of slots in the chassis.
Slots.longDescription: The value of this property shall be a link to a collection of type LenovoSlotCollection.

LEDs.description: This object describes the LEDs of the system.
LEDs.longDescription: This is a reference to LED. This object shall contain properties which describes the LEDs for the current resource.

ProductName.description: This property describes the product name.
ProductName.longDescription: This property describes the product name.

FruPartNumber.description: This property describes the fru part number.
FruPartNumber.longDescription: This property describes the fru part number.

SystemBoardSerialNumber.description: This property describes the system board serial number.
SystemBoardSerialNumber.longDescription: This property describes the system board serial number.

LocatedIn.description: This is location of the chassis in general detail.
LocatedIn.longDescription: This values will give out a detailed description to the location where the chassis is placed .

LenovoChassisProperties.description: These properties shall be refered in /schemas/v1/Chassis.v1_0_0.json#/definitions/Chassis/properties/Oem.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

FirmwareInfo.description: This is an array of references to the firmware that this chassis has installed.
FirmwareInfo.longDescription: This property shall contain an array of references to firmware resources of which this chassis has installed.

LenovoChassisLinks.description: These properties shall be refered in /schemas/v1/Chassis.v1_0_0.json#/definitions/Chassis/properties/Links/Oem.
